items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: Then Wilbur called me and wanted me to come back in the band.

ctx.x: So in order to read the stocks... But of course, Bechet, you worked on and off with him in this immediate period after the Second World War. You recorded with him and Art Hodes in '45, and a few years later you were with him at Jimmy Ryan's -- in '47 you played with him, with Sidney Bechet. Did he have his tailor shop here in Harlem at the time?

I think he did. I'm not sure. Because he was... When I first met him, I think he was living...he was in Brooklyn. He was living in Brooklyn. We made recordings (I don't know if they ever came out or not) when he lived on Christie Street. That's when... He had an apartment on Christie Street. He was living in Brooklyn. I used to do a lot of rehearsing with him. I had go over to Brooklyn to rehearse. I don't... I was doing so many things. Bob
